cards.card_text: God says their offering will be reckoned to them as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.
cards.verse_text: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.
cards.snippet: …to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.

cards.card_text: God says it again: once they've presented the best part, it's reckoned to them as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.
cards.verse_text: Therefore say to the Levites, ‘When you have presented the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.
cards.snippet: …be reckoned to you as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.

cards.card_text: When a master frees his Hebrew servant, he sends him off with plenty from his flock, his threshing floor and his winepress.
cards.verse_text: You are to furnish him liberally from your flock, your threshing floor, and your winepress.
cards.snippet: …to furnish him liberally from your flock, your threshing floor, and your winepress.

cards.card_text: After gathering from the threshing floor and winepress Before the first seed goes into the ground Right at the start of the month of Abib
cards.verse_text: You are to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.
cards.snippet: …after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.

cards.card_text: In a winepress In a cave Inside his house
cards.verse_text: Then the angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites.
cards.snippet: …Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites.

cards.card_text: They also capture Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian, killing Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb.
cards.verse_text: They also captured Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian; and they killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb.
cards.snippet: …they killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb.

cards.card_text: In those days, Nehemiah sees people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath.
cards.verse_text: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys, along with wine, grapes, and figs.
cards.snippet: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys,…

cards.card_text: The poor carry the sheaves, crush the olives and tread the winepresses.
cards.verse_text: They crush olives within their walls; they tread the winepresses, but go thirsty.
cards.snippet: They crush olives within their walls; they tread the winepresses, but go thirsty.

cards.card_text: A winepress A well A storehouse
cards.verse_text: He built a watchtower in the middle and dug out a winepress as well.
cards.snippet: He built a watchtower in the middle and dug out a winepress as well.

cards.card_text: Treads the winepress Works the threshing floor Tends the altar fire
cards.verse_text: Why are Your clothes red, and Your garments like one who treads the winepress?
cards.snippet: …are Your clothes red, and Your garments like one who treads the winepress?

cards.card_text: The One from Edom answers that He has trodden the winepress alone.
cards.verse_text: “I have trodden the winepress alone, and no one from the nations was with Me.
cards.snippet: “I have trodden the winepress alone, and no one from the nations was with Me.

cards.card_text: Like grapes in a winepress, the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.
cards.verse_text: Like grapes in a winepress, the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.
cards.snippet: Like grapes in a winepress, the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.

cards.card_text: True or false: The threshing floor and the winepress will keep feeding Israel.
cards.verse_text: The threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and the new wine will fail them.
cards.snippet: The threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and the new wine will fail them.

cards.card_text: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe, and trample the grapes, for the winepress is full.
cards.verse_text: Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.
cards.snippet: Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.

cards.card_text: Only ten, and at the winepress they came to draw out fifty baths and got twenty.
cards.verse_text: When one came to the winepress to draw out fifty baths, there were but twenty.
cards.snippet: When one came to the winepress to draw out fifty baths, there were but twenty.

cards.card_text: All the land from Geba to Rimmon, south of Jerusalem, will be turned into a plain, but Jerusalem will be raised up and will remain in her place, from gate to gate and tower to winepresses.
cards.verse_text: All the land from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem will be turned into a plain, but Jerusalem will be raised up and will remain in her place, from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses.
cards.snippet: …the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses.

cards.card_text: A landowner plants a vineyard, puts a wall around it, digs a winepress in it and builds a tower.
cards.verse_text: He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower.
cards.snippet: He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower.

cards.card_text: Into the great winepress of God's wrath Into the fire on the altar Into the storehouse of the temple
cards.verse_text: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the grapes of the earth, and he threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
cards.snippet: …the grapes of the earth, and he threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.

cards.card_text: The great winepress of God's wrath is trodden inside the city.
cards.verse_text: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and the blood that flowed from it rose as high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
cards.snippet: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and the blood that flowed from it…

cards.card_text: The winepress is trodden outside the city, and the blood that flows from it rises as high as the bridles of the horses, for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
cards.verse_text: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and the blood that flowed from it rose as high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
cards.snippet: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and the blood that flowed from it…

cards.card_text: And John says He treads a winepress.
cards.verse_text: He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
cards.snippet: He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.

cards.card_text: The rider treads the winepress of the fury of someone's wrath.
cards.verse_text: He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
cards.snippet: He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
